description: Color picker, palette generator with color harmonies, image color extraction, gradients, WCAG contrast checker, color blindness simulator, inline color pickers and live editing of the colors in your code.
configuration.title: Color Palette Creator
configuration.historySize: Maximum number of colors kept in the color history.
configuration.defaultExportFormat: Default format used when exporting or inserting a palette.
configuration.showStatusBarItem: Show a status bar button that opens the Color Palette Creator.
configuration.inlineColors.enabled: Show a color box with a color picker in front of color codes (HEX, RGB(A), HSL(A), HSV(A)) in the editor.
configuration.inlineColors.excludedLangu: Language IDs in which no inline color boxes are shown.
configuration.inlineColors.builtInLangua: Languages that already have a built-in color provider. Only colors it does not support (HSV, Bootstrap RGB triplets) are added there to avoid duplicate color boxes.
configuration.documentColors.autoSave: Save the document automatically after changing a color in the Document tab (useful with live reload servers).
